dialect.detail: IBM CICS/TS COBOL program using EXEC CICS asynchronous child transaction API (RUN TRANSID/FETCH CHILD), compiled with PROCESS CICS,NODYNAM,NSYMBOL(NATIONAL),TRUNC(STD) compiler options. IBM sample code copyright 2016.
evidence: EXEC CICS FETCH CHILD ... COMPSTATUS ... ABCODE

purpose.domain_detail: Credit card application processing using CICS asynchronous child transactions
purpose.summary: ASYNCPNT is a CICS parent coordinating program that processes a credit card application asynchronously. It accepts a customer account number from either a terminal (transaction ACCA) or a web service, then fans out to multiple child transactions (credit check, name lookup, address lookup, customer status, DB cache update) using the CICS asynchronous API (RUN TRANSID/FETCH CHILD), collects results, and returns a consolidated response.

notable_features: EXEC CICS RUN TRANSID ... CHILD (CICS asynchronous child transaction API)
EXEC CICS FETCH CHILD ... COMPSTATUS ... ABCODE
EXEC CICS PUT/GET CONTAINER with named channels
Dual invocation path: terminal (STARTCODE=TD) and web service
COMP-5 SYNC for binary length field
No EXEC SQL, no COPY statements
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars but the essential logic is visible. This is an IBM-supplied sample program (copyright IBM Corp. 2016) demonstrating the CICS asynchronous API introduced in CICS TS 5.2+. All error handling is intentionally omitted per the program comments. The program is well-structured and representative of production CICS coding style despite being a sample.
